The panel consensus, supported by five of six panelists citing evidence E3, is that the upgraded plant's design capacity is 62 million litres per day. All panelists unanimously agree, citing evidence E5, that the contractor dispute halted work for 5 months in 2023.

Answer: 62 million litres per day; 5 months.

The panel unanimously agrees that the upgraded plant's design capacity is 62 million litres per day (E3) and that the contractor dispute halted work for 5 months (E5). One panelist initially reported 68 million litres per day, but the strong consensus supports 62 million.

Answer: 62 million litres per day; 5 months.

All panelists agree that in the NVX-204 trial, the peloxatril arm had 96 responders out of 240 participants (40%) and the placebo arm had 60 responders out of 240 (25%). The absolute difference between the arms is 15 percentage points.

Answer: Peloxatril responder rate 40%; placebo responder rate 25%; absolute difference 15 percentage points.

All panelists agree: with 240 participants per arm, peloxatril had 96 responders (40%) and placebo had 60 responders (25%). The absolute difference is 15 percentage points.

Answer: Peloxatril responder rate 40% (96/240); placebo responder rate 25% (60/240); absolute difference 15 percentage points.

The panel unanimously agrees that Tessaly Robotics' fiscal-2025 revenue was $214 million (E1) and its operating margin was 9.4% (E3).

Answer: $214 million revenue; 9.4% operating margin.

The panel unanimously agrees that Tessaly Robotics' fiscal-2025 revenue was $214 million (E1) and its operating margin was 9.4% (E3). A single outlier's 12.6% figure was rejected as unsupported by the shared evidence.

Answer: $214 million revenue; 9.4% operating margin.

The first failures occurred at 09:42 UTC, and full service was restored at 11:58 UTC. The elapsed time between these two points is 2 hours and 16 minutes (136 minutes). All panelists agree on this figure, noting that a 1-hour-16-minute result found elsewhere is an arithmetic error.

Answer: 2 hours and 16 minutes

The outage began with first failures at 09:42 UTC and ended with full service restoration at 11:58 UTC, lasting 2 hours and 16 minutes (136 minutes).

Answer: 2 hours and 16 minutes
